investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Juniperari Cloud (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Microsoft Azure uksouth (zones uksouth-1/uksouth-2/uksouth-3); network range 10.26.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster junipe-prod-uksout (AKS); Database: mysql server search-db-01 reachable from the application network only through NSG search-db-01-nsg rule Allow-App-3306; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
